secrets.name: MPESA_CONSUMER_KEY
secrets.description: Safaricom Daraja consumer key. Get it at developer.safaricom.co.ke → Apps → your app → Keys.

secrets.name: MPESA_CONSUMER_SECRET
secrets.description: Safaricom Daraja consumer secret (same Keys page as the consumer key).

secrets.name: MPESA_SHORTCODE
secrets.description: Business shortcode (Paybill or Till number) used for Lipa Na M-Pesa Online.

secrets.name: MPESA_PASSKEY
secrets.description: Lipa Na M-Pesa Online passkey issued for that shortcode.

secrets.name: MPESA_ENV
secrets.description: Either sandbox or production. Defaults to sandbox when unset.

secrets.name: MPESA_CALLBACK_URL
secrets.description: Optional public HTTPS callback URL. Leave unset to use the preview URL automatically.
